input.quote: 8.1 Fee Structure. Schedule 8.1 attached hereto (the "Fee Schedule") sets forth the costs and charges to be paid by Customer for the Services.
input.rationale: Repeated targeted searches (most favoured/favored nation, "less favorable", best/lowest price, matching a third-party or competing offer, price-list comparisons to other customers) and a read of the whole fee architecture (Article 8, including 8.1–8.14 and the pricing-modification mechanic in 8.14) return no most-favoured-nation, best-terms or right-to-match obligation running in M&I's favour. Pricing is fixed by the Fee Schedule, with discounts flowing to Customer (8.9) and only a default-triggered reversion to M&I standard published prices (8.14A), which is a pricing remedy, not an MFN. Article 3 (Appointment) likewise imposes no obligation on Customer to extend to M&I any terms given to third parties. The Agreement therefore meets the preferred position — Customer bears no MFN obligation benefiting Vendor — and no redline is required; an MFN in Customer's favour is optional and its absence is noted only as a commercial observation, not a deviation.
